evidence.detail: Commit 'welcome and back-for-more commands' (2024-04-05) added the /welcome slash command, well after issue creation 2020-03-29
Welcome extension defines /welcome slash command that fetches oracle.cards_by_name()['Welcome to the Fold'] and sends it with card art via image_fetcher

triage.notes: PR #12137 merged this feature. The back-for-more companion command was added in the same commit.
triage.proposed_comment: The /welcome command was added in commit 2f267103 and is live in discordbot/commands/welcome.py. It posts 'Welcome to the Fold' card art as requested.
